in_marathi.name: Kaalin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaalin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kaalin is a name associated with Lord Shiva, the god of destruction. The name symbolizes the dark power and strength of the deity. Kaalin is also a term used to describe the dark, unchanging nature of the universe.
